news.headline: SBP FX reserves jump $1.94bn to $18.47bn
news.summary: SBP-held reserves rose $1.94bn (+11.76% WoW) to $18.47bn in the week ended Jul 3, 2026 - supportive for PKR and macro stability.

news.headline: Worker remittances fall to $3.47bn in June
news.summary: June 2026 remittances $3.47bn, down 18.3% MoM but up 2% YoY.

news.headline: Bank Alfalah's Rs20bn Tier-2 TFC fully subscribed
news.summary: BAFL's Rs20,000,000,000 Tier-2 Term Finance Certificate issue fully subscribed with SBP approval - strengthens capital base.

news.headline: OGDC's entire BESOS trust shareholding transferred back to GoP
news.summary: Transfer of OGDC shares held under the BESOS employee trust back to the Government of Pakistan completed - routine shareholding change.

news.headline: PSX reconstitutes JS Momentum Factor Index
news.summary: Effective Jul 7, 2026: added SSGC, SNGP, GAL, PSX, ILP, THCCL, PIAHCLA, TOMCL; removed AIRLINK, FCCL, FrieslandCampina, FFC, PPL, PTC, SAZEW, TRG; MLCF and DGKC now top weights at 20% each.

news.headline: ADB slashes Pakistan FY27 growth forecast
news.summary: ADB cut its Pakistan FY27 growth forecast; economy expanded 3.7% in FY2025-26 per the briefing.

news.headline: Record 48% surge in stock market investors in FY26
news.summary: SECP data: 190,277 new investors joined PSX in FY2025-26, a 48% surge - structural positive for exchange volumes.

news.headline: RDA attracts $306m in June
news.summary: Roshan Digital Account inflows of $306m in June 2026; cumulative total $13,365m.

news.headline: PKR holds firm below 278.20
news.summary: Rupee settled at Rs278.05 per USD, a modest gain, despite oil-driven import cost concerns.

news.headline: Pakistan's IT sector exports $4.5bn in FY26 amid Asia-Pacific push
news.summary: IT exports reached approximately $4.5bn in FY2025-26 - supportive backdrop for listed tech exporters.

news.headline: SECP unveils digital KYC for investors
news.summary: SECP introduced a digital KYC framework to simplify access to capital markets and insurance - onboarding tailwind for retail participation.

news.headline: Govt showcases record Sukuk issuance, debt market growth
news.summary: PSX and Ministry of Finance held an investor briefing on debt management strategy, record Sukuk issuance and fiscal reforms.

news.headline: Meezan Bank, Iqra University introduce Islamic FinTech centre
news.summary: MEBL partnered with Iqra University to establish the IU Centre for Excellence in Islamic FinTech - reputational, not financial.

news.headline: PSX opens week in the red, plummets amid US-Iran Strait of Hormuz escalation
news.summary: Monday session (intraday): KSE-100 Index lost 2,215.27 points at 10:19am to stand at 180,026.5 (previous close 182,241.77); as of 12:33pm down 1,706.67 points (-0.94%) to 180,535.10; Business Recorder later reported the index shed 2,202.63 points to 180,039.14. Driver: US and Iran exchanged fresh strikes over the Strait of Hormuz, Iran claimed to have closed the strait, oil prices jumped over 4%; across-the-board selling in autos, cement, banks, E&P, OMCs and power, with HUBCO, MARI, OGDC, PSO, SSGC, SNGPL, MCB, MEBL, NBP and UBL trading in the red; refinery sector was the lone positive per Dawn.

news.headline: Govt unveils new plan to fast track $6 billion refinery upgrade projects
news.summary: Petroleum Division submitted amendments to the Brownfield Refining Policy 2023 to the Cabinet Committee on Energy: refineries (PARCO, Attock Refinery/ARL, Pakistan Refinery/PRL, National Refinery/NRL, Cnergyico) that sign OGRA Upgrade Agreements within 90 days get a seven-year package - minimum 10% customs/regulatory duty maintained on imported gasoline and diesel for seven years, a 10% deemed duty incentive on locally produced gasoline/diesel, and sales tax exemption on imported plant, machinery, equipment and materials - to unlock nearly $6 billion in upgrades.
